fact: The 2021 annual report records the crime-reporting mobile app piloted at Kairaba police station, linked to the case management system, with 7,560 crimes of 2019 entered and 24 officers trained, and extension planned to Basse, Janjanbureh, Mansankonko and Barra.
title: PBF Project Progress Report, Annual 2021: Strengthening Community Access to Justice, Community Policing and Effective SGBV Response
